'''Zephyr''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] for boots that turns sneaking into a high jump. Higher levels add a slow descent and a charged updraft.

== Obtaining ==
The [[Elegy of Hyacinthus]] gives Zephyr I, stored directly, so two elegies can be combined in an [[anvil]] into a Zephyr II book. Higher levels also come from combining two boots with the same level of Zephyr.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/zephyr.json}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
All effects are checked every tick while the boots are worn.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/zephyr.json}}</ref>

{| class="wikitable"
! Level !! Effect
|-
| I || While sneaking, the wearer has {{EffectLink|Jump Boost}} VII (renewed for 0.25 seconds each tick), and dust plume particles rise around their feet.
|-
| II || As level I, and the wearer also has {{EffectLink|Slow Falling}} II while sneaking.
|-
| III || As level II, and the wearer can charge an updraft. Each tick spent sneaking adds to the charge; after 45 ticks (2.25 seconds) of continuous sneaking, a dust burst and a chime mark it as ready.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/zephyr/charge.mcfunction}}</ref> Releasing sneak while in the air with a full charge plays a wind burst sound with gust and poof particles and gives {{EffectLink|Levitation}} XIII for 1 second, launching the wearer upward.<ref name="apply">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/zephyr/apply.mcfunction}}</ref> Releasing sneak before the charge is full, or while standing on the ground, cancels the charge.
|}

The usual way to use it is to sneak on the ground until the charge is ready, jump, and let go of sneak in mid-air. Since the charge is kept while sneaking, the wearer can also charge while drifting down under Slow Falling and release in the air.<ref name="apply" />

Zephyr's anvil cost multiplier is 0.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.3-alpha|Re-added the "ping" sound.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|No longer spams its sound while under Slow Falling. The wind burst is quieter.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Reworked into three levels.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=Zephyr enchantment reworked so that its 3 levels}}</ref> Moved from the <code>main</code> to the <code>matcha</code> namespace, although the Elegy of Hyacinthus still gave the old enchantment.}}
{{History line|1.12.3|The Elegy of Hyacinthus stores Zephyr directly, so two elegies can be combined into a Zephyr II book.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/zephyr.json}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|The level III updraft was reworked. The charge must now be built in one continuous sneak, and it is cancelled by releasing sneak on the ground or before it is full; before, sneak time added up across separate sneaks. The launch no longer requires Slow Falling to still be active, and a release without a full charge no longer plays the wind burst sound.<ref name="apply" />}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* Zephyrus is the Greek god of the west wind. In myth, Hyacinthus was loved by both Zephyrus and Apollo, which is why the Zephyr blessing is the [[Elegy of Hyacinthus]].
